name: Kalpataru Magnus
address: Near MIG Club, Gandhi Nagar, Kala Nagar, Bandra East, Mumbai 400051
amenities: Spa with steam and massage room
Swimming pool and children's pool with pool deck
description: Three-tower (Wings A-C) luxury redevelopment on 2.24 acres in Kala Nagar, Bandra East, next to the Bandra Kurla Complex and Western Express Highway. Kalpataru launched it in May 2018 with 2, 3, 4 and 4.5 BHK homes designed by Sanjay Puri. Its saleable area is 0.52 million sq ft. In 2026 it was nearing completion, past its original MahaRERA date.
notes: Kalpataru's IPO RHP (June 2025) lists Magnus as a 100%-owned redevelopment (development agreement) held by subsidiary Kalpataru Properties Pvt Ltd, with construction commenced 19 May 2017. The RHP gives an estimated RERA completion of 30 Jun 2025 and lists 28 MahaRERA complaints from buyers over alleged possession delays, which KPPL contests. The RHP also lists Magnus among projects that have made lifecycle losses. Square Yards' MahaRERA data: original completion 30 Jun 2024, revised to 31 Mar 2026. Construction progress in Dec 2025: external works 82%, internal finishing 78%, MEP 93%. Housiey (Nov 2026) says construction is 100% complete, and Mumbai Property Exchange says OC and possession were underway for Towers A and B. No OC date was confirmed, so status is kept as under_construction. Unit count conflicts: 250 launched units on Square Yards (178 booked by Dec 2025) vs 364 units on Mumbai Property Exchange's MahaRERA summary; total_units is omitted. Floors conflict: registrations go up to the 30th floor, listings say 26-31 floors and MahaRERA says up to 34; floors_max is omitted. A Jan 2024 plan to demerge 'Project Magnus' into Kalpataru Ltd was withdrawn on 2 Jun 2026. Housiey lists Bombay High Court writ petitions (2015, 2017), NGT appeals (2016) and a Lokayukta matter (2016) involving the project. Awards: Franchise India 'Luxury Project of the Year (West)' 2020; Asia Pacific Property Awards 2020 (redevelopment). No launch-price list was found; the earliest price is the RHP's FY22 average. Mumbai Property Exchange gives the BKC metro station 0.3 km away but Line 3 1.9 km away (straight line), so nearest_metro is omitted.
architect: Sanjay Puri (concept); Burega Farnell (landscape and interiors); Jethe & Associates (architect on MahaRERA record)

news.title: Kalpataru launches its luxury project Kalpataru Magnus in Bandra (East)
news.summary: Kalpataru launched 2, 3, 4 and 4.5 BHK homes at Kala Nagar near BKC and the proposed Metro Line 3 BKC station, designed by Sanjay Puri with landscape and interiors by Burega Farnell.

news.title: Kalpataru RHP lists 28 MahaRERA complaints over Magnus possession delays
news.summary: 28 complaints by Magnus buyers sought refunds or interest for alleged possession delays, which the developer contests. The RHP gives an estimated RERA completion of 30 Jun 2025.

news.title: Kalpataru withdraws demerger scheme for Project Magnus
news.summary: Kalpataru withdrew the Jan 2024 scheme to demerge Magnus from its subsidiary Kalpataru Properties into the parent, saying the benefits were 'no longer relevant'. The scheme had been filed with NCLT in Sep 2024.
